text:
eli: opened a compact PR to clarify metering headers, add a tiny demo CSV, and include PromQL for the new quota dashboard. PR: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/2468

zoe: thanks! can you include a one-line curl and a short python/requests example for the meter header? most tickets are malformed headers.

eli: will do. canonical curl in the PR description: 

curl -X POST https://api.redwood.inference/v1/usage \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' \
  -H 'X-Redwood-Meter: tenant=acme-prod;billing_unit=tokens;amount=1024' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"timestamp":"2026-07-01T12:00:00Z","route":"/v1/generate","tokens":1024}'

matt: tiny UX nit: change table column "unit" -> "billing_unit" across the page and add a short footnote: "billing_unit is the unit used for billing calculations (usually tokens for generation APIs)."

eli: updated table and added the footnote. also added a 3-row demo CSV and a one-line sqlite import instruction: 

2026-07-01T12:00:00Z,acme-prod,generation,512
2026-07-01T12:01:00Z,acme-prod,generation,256
2026-07-01T12:02:00Z,acme-prod,generation,1024

sqlite3 demo.db '.mode csv' '.import demo_usage.csv usage'

zoe: please include PromQL so reviewers can import and validate panels quickly: 

sum(increase(redwood_meter_tokens_total[1h])) by (tenant)

matt: add a short note about burst credits and how they render: they appear on `redwood_burst_credit_balance` (separate axis) and do not reduce historical billed units. callers sometimes misread negative adjustments.

eli: added burst-credit FAQ and an example PromQL to overlay credits: 

redwood_burst_credit_balance{tenant="acme-prod"}

qa-bot: linkcheck and lint started for PR #2468.

zoe: include a migration blurb: older SDKs used `X-Redwood-Quota`. show one-liner converter in the PR so integrators can backfill.

eli: added converter snippet and a small JS fetch example with security warning (server-side only for keys).

docs-bot: preview available at https://deploy-preview-2468--docs.redwood.ai/ (checks: lint, linkcheck)

matt: LGTM after preview check. one last ask: add PromQL for rate-limit smoothing panel so platform teams can tune thresholds: 

avg(rate(redwood_rate_limiter_credits_total[5m])) by (tenant)

eli: done. merging after green checks. will follow up with localized snippets (fr/es) in a follow-up PR.

docs-bot: PR #2468 merged by eli. release note: "metering/docs: canonical meter header examples, demo CSV, PromQL for quota dashboards, migration note for old headers"
